responsibility: This file implements GCC’s OpenMP/OpenACC expansion pass that takes lowered GIMPLE_OMP regions and turns them into executable middle-end form just before later code generation. It owns the omp_region region tree and CFG edge modeling for structured OpenMP/OpenACC constructs, outlines parallel/task/target-style regions into child functions when needed, recognizes combined parallel-worksharing cases, and rewrites region markers into explicit libgomp/libgoacc runtime calls, loop/control-flow scaffolding, and offload entry sequencing. It also provides the expand_omp and expand_omp_ssa passes and the omp_make_gimple_edges helper used when building CFG structure around GIMPLE_OMP statements.
same_name_distinction: Implements the expansion stage behind omp-expand.h’s small API: it defines the internal omp_region tree and the pass logic that turns lowered GIMPLE_OMP regions into CFG edges, outlined child functions, and runtime calls. Unlike gcc/omp-expand.h, this file owns the expansion algorithms and region bookkeeping rather than just declaring entry points such as omp_make_gimple_edges.
